utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can head over for the repair drive now—what’s the address?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’m at 14 Maple Street—just ring the side bell when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: On my way now—see you at the side bell.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and where the drop-off is first. I’m a bit worried about coordinating everything smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Fair enough — can you confirm the timing and the exact drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, once you send me the timing and the exact drop-off spot. I just want to make sure I can coordinate it cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right—what day is that again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I’m blanking on the exact day too — I think it’s sometime this week. Let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — I’d appreciate that. I’ve been meaning to help, I just keep losing track of the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll let folks know about the repair drive and keep repeating the plan around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and if you hear anything new, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries—you didn’t miss it. I can fill you in and lend a hand if you need any tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus—that’d be great. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple and steady. Tell me the time and place, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — we’re meeting Saturday at 10 by the community shed. I’ll spread the word, and it should be an easy one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Saturday at 10 by the community shed works for me. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — we’re still on. Bring the tools around 10:00, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring them around 10:00. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—I'm mainly looking for people who can help with appliance fixes and basic carpentry, and I can share the locations once I know who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can reach out to a couple neighbors who do that kind of work and see who’s available. If you want, I can also help match them to the locations once you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what still needs doing and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara—that helps a lot. I’ll send you the current list, and you can pick what fits your time best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—send it over, and I’ll take a look as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a quick list of supplies we’ll need for the repair drive. Want me to compare it with what Bo already has?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, please do — I’m pretty slammed, so a quick compare would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — send me Bo’s list, and I’ll cross-check it with what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are pitching in to get it wrapped up soon—sounds like a real community effort.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it’s nice to see everyone helping out. I might stop by and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nice, they’d probably appreciate another pair of hands. If you go, tell me what they still need—I’m sure there’s plenty of gossip and good work to catch up on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details first—what still needs to be sorted out?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still need to confirm the drop-off time and make sure we have a final list of items. Once that’s set, I can send everything out to parents.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds right—can you confirm the drop-off time first, then I’ll help check the final item list?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the basics for the repair drive and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll send the basics over once I’m back from my errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — just the key details are all I need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m in for the repair drive—I’ll pass the word along and keep folks posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a huge help. I really appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan and let everyone know what’s needed. I’ll check back in with any updates as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, so what’s the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think they’re collecting repairs at the community center this Saturday. I can check the exact drop-off time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d help—please check the drop-off time for me. I don’t want to show up too early or miss it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what’s most needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could really use a ladder, a drill, and a few screwdrivers if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got a drill and a couple screwdrivers I can bring by. I’ll check on a ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep us organized and make sure the repair drive runs smoothly. What should we prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the drop-off spot and the list of needed repairs, so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll mark out the drop-off spot and start a clean repair list right away. If you think of any must-haves, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. Can we sort out the details before we start?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s nail it down first. I can start a quick list of who’s bringing what and when we’re kicking off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—can we keep it simple and make sure we’ve got all the tools covered too?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but I’d like to confirm the details before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so we shouldn’t assume it’s locked in yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably swing by a little late, but I can still help set up and haul stuff. If you can grab the sign-up sheet and a couple extension cords, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and two extension cords, and I’ll be ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces second-hand, but I’m glad folks are pulling together for it. If you tell me what’s needed, I can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — we mostly need tape, zip ties, work gloves, and a few flashlights. I’ll keep a running list and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out for anything else folks mention.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m sorry, Mara, my memory’s a bit foggy today, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren — could you help set up the table and keep an eye on the tools? That would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, Mara — I can do that. I’ll set up the table and keep an eye on the tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around school pickup times — what day are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning would be best for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work for me too, as long as we can wrap up before pickup time.
